scope: Only diff from preserved initially reviewed driver; no execution/inference/host queries or broad tests. Original normalization/order/native/request-loop blocks unchanged.
findings: Post-normalization unchanged normal_ready.run("admission",output) has600s maximum and stores local readiness proof/JSONL; nonzero readiness fails before native creation.
Fresh admission uses that local matched proof, rechecks actual sameguard identity/balanced/noholds/package<=55C and AC/openlid, and refuses native spawn on failure.

Full live fresh-admission record is written in finally and linked from result even when a live condition rejects admission. An unmatched normal-ready wait instead retains its own proof/rows and exits before invoking fresh capture.
AC/lid helper now returns diagnostic errors/ready; caller explicitly requires ready both before native spawn and before first request.

Root supplies existing owned process guard plus outer960-second timeout. The driver separately bounds600s readiness,30s native readiness/response,300s postready request budget and12s live capture; setup/IO/cleanup are not absorbed into postready time.
limits: Same-service recovered journal plus sampled temperature/policy is inferred readiness, not direct thermal-guard latch observation.
A live policy can still change after admission; collection must report actual sampled state without assuming readiness persists.
